commit 84937a10ad3e554f655f149493ceeffa1714b058
Author:     Richard Marti <richard.marti@gmail.com>
AuthorDate: Thu Jul 3 17:46:00 2025 +0000
Commit:     Richard Marti <richard.marti@gmail.com>
CommitDate: Thu Jul 3 17:46:00 2025 +0000

    Bug 1975490 - Port bug 1972782: Make MOZ_WINCONSOLE a first class citizen of moz.build as WINCONSOLE r=aleca
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D255989

diff --git a/mail/app/Makefile.in b/mail/app/Makefile.in
index c4b07f3d2da..b50bde47ad6 100644
--- a/mail/app/Makefile.in
+++ b/mail/app/Makefile.in
@@ -11,14 +11,6 @@ MOZ_BUILDID = $(shell $(PYTHON3) $(topsrcdir)/config/printconfigsetting.py $(DIS
 
 # Build a binary bootstrapping with XRE_main
 
-ifndef MOZ_WINCONSOLE
-ifdef MOZ_DEBUG
-MOZ_WINCONSOLE = 1
-else
-MOZ_WINCONSOLE = 0
-endif
-endif
-
 include $(topsrcdir)/config/config.mk
 
 # If we are trying to show an error dialog about the lack of SSE2 support,
diff --git a/mail/app/moz.build b/mail/app/moz.build
index 6896d86e67f..2557032d0ab 100644
--- a/mail/app/moz.build
+++ b/mail/app/moz.build
@@ -129,3 +129,8 @@ for icon in ("messengerWindow", "newmail", "writeMessage", "addressbook"):
         CONFIG["MOZ_BRANDING_DIRECTORY"],
         icon,
     )
+
+if CONFIG["MOZ_ASAN"] or CONFIG["MOZ_DEBUG"]:
+    WINCONSOLE = True
+else:
+    WINCONSOLE = False
diff --git a/mail/components/search/wsenable/Makefile.in b/mail/components/search/wsenable/Makefile.in
index 254509ee779..b51f7b852db 100644
--- a/mail/components/search/wsenable/Makefile.in
+++ b/mail/components/search/wsenable/Makefile.in
@@ -2,5 +2,3 @@
 # This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
 # License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
 # file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
-
-MOZ_WINCONSOLE = 0
diff --git a/mail/components/search/wsenable/moz.build b/mail/components/search/wsenable/moz.build
index bf9cdab1dc9..4cc6acd8d0a 100644
--- a/mail/components/search/wsenable/moz.build
+++ b/mail/components/search/wsenable/moz.build
@@ -19,3 +19,5 @@ RCINCLUDE = "WSEnable.rc"
 
 # This isn't XPCOM code, but it wants to use STL so disable STL wrappers
 DisableStlWrapping()
+
+WINCONSOLE = False
